data.summary:
Having 5 years of professional experience in the IT industry, with Microsoft Power Platform.
Detail-oriented Power Platform Developer with 4 years of hands-on experience in designing,
developing, and deploying low-code/no-code business solutions using Microsoft Power Apps, Power
Automate, Power BI, and Dataverse. Skilled in integrating Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and external
systems to streamline business processes, automate workflows, and enhance productivity. Strong
analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a focus on delivering scalable enterprise
solutions.
2 years of hands-on experience with Java, JavaScript implementation , AWS, and Sql .
Experience in UiPath development ,automating business process and integrating with Power platform .
Worked with UiPath studio & Orchestrator , including scheduling , monitoring and exception handling .
Completely involved in requirement analysis phase

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Optimum Infosystems Pvt. Ltd. — Power Platform Developer
June 2024 – Present | Bangalore
Designed and implemented Power Apps Canvas and Model-Driven applications to automate client business
processes.
Developed automated workflows using Power Automate for approval processes, notifications, and data
synchronization.
Integrated Power Apps with SharePoint Online and Dataverse, improving data accessibility and accuracy.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, create prototypes, and deliver end-to-end Power
Platform solutions.
Supported ongoing maintenance, performance tuning, and version upgrades of Power Platform environments.
Capgemini Technology Services — Power Platform Developer Sep 2021 – Jan 2023 | Bangalore
Built custom Power Apps solutions for HR and Finance departments, reducing manual efforts by 40%.
Automated recurring reporting and notification tasks using Power Automate, integrating SharePoint lists and
Outlook.
• Created dashboards in Power BI to visualize KPIs and operational data, enabling real-time insights.
• Provided user training, documentation, and post-deployment support to business teams.
• Worked in Agile teams, participating in sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.
Vodafone Shared Services — Junior Power Platform Developer
May 2020 – Sep 2021 | Pune/Bangalore
Assisted in developing Power Apps for internal process automation and data collection.
Supported development of approval and reminder flows using Power Automate.
Created SharePoint lists, custom forms, and connectors to enhance process efficiency.
Gained foundational knowledge in Power Platform administration and environment management.
Prime KI Software Solutions , Software engineer
May 15 2017 - Sep 2019
Xemplar Solutions Suite is a digital transformation platform for Personal & Commercial Auto Carriers to collect, analyse and apply deeper insights to their business.
Development of client side interfaces as per the requirements.
Developed multi-threaded applications leveraging java utilities.
Applied java design patterns (singleton,factory)in system design.
Created and worked on ticketing API with real time notifications.
Worked Sql for developing Joins implementations ..
